funding_summary: In 2019, Carbomed secured €500,000 from investors Hans-Peter Haselsteiner, Leo Hillinger, and Martin Rohla. In 2020, the company raised an additional €3 million to support international expansion and product development. As of 2024, Carbomed reported a balance sheet total of €693,900 and an equity ratio of 82.5%.
